candidates.formal_type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group.{u_1} G] {j : Nat},
  (Nat.card.{u_1} G).Coprime j → Function.Bijective.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} fun g => HPow.hPow.{u_1, 0, u_1} g j

∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group.{u_1} G] {M : Type u_2} [inst_1 : CommMonoid.{u_2} M] [inst_2 : Fintype.{u_1} G]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} G] {j : Nat},
  (Nat.card.{u_1} G).Coprime j →
    ∀ (f : G → M),
      Eq.{u_2 + 1}
        (Finset.prod.{u_1, u_2} (Finset.filter.{u_1} (fun x => Ne.{u_1 + 1} x 1) Finset.univ.{u_1}) fun g =>
          f (HPow.hPow.{u_1, 0, u_1} g j))
        (Finset.prod.{u_1, u_2} (Finset.filter.{u_1} (fun x => Ne.{u_1 + 1} x 1) Finset.univ.{u_1}) fun g => f g)
